heading: Monday Night
text: Gradual clearing from north to south. Lows from the mid 20s to lower 30s, with some mid 30s near Lake Champlain and some lower 20s in northern cold hollows. Northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming north and diminishing, except gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny. Valley highs in the low to mid 50s in the south, and mid 40s to around 50 north. North winds 5 to 15 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mostly clear. Lows from the upper teens to mid 20s, except low to mid teens in northern cold hollows. Winds diminishing to light and variable.
